login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with the username (or NIP) and password of your Sentra DCIM account.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
login.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.forgot: Forgot your password or account locked? Contact your Sentra DCIM administrator.

forced.title: Change password
forced.description: Hello {{name}}, your account was just created or its password was reset.
forced.why: For security, replace this temporary password before using the application.

password.title: Change password
password.description: After the change, every other session of this account is signed out. This session stays active.
password.hint: {{min}}–{{max}} characters. A long phrase you can remember is safer than a short complex word.
password.policy: The new password must be {{min}}–{{max}} characters.
password.same: The new password must differ from the current one.
password.mismatch: The repeated new password does not match.
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.description: Devices currently signed in with your account. Revoke any session you do not recognise, then change your password.
sessions.note: Sessions end automatically after a period without activity or a fixed time after sign-in (column Ends at the latest). To end this session, use Sign out in the user menu.

mfa.enrolDescription: Every Sentra DCIM account must use a code from an authenticator app on a phone in addition to the password.
mfa.verifyDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from the authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.stepInstall: Install an authenticator app on your phone: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy.
mfa.stepScan: Select Start, then scan the QR code that appears with that app.
mfa.stepCode: Type the 6-digit code shown by the app to activate it.
mfa.scanHint: In the authenticator app choose Add account → Scan a QR code.
mfa.manualHint: Cannot scan? Choose Enter a setup key and type the data below.
mfa.codeHint: The code changes every 30 seconds. Each code can be used only once.
mfa.recoveryHint: One of the 10 backup codes you saved when setting up MFA. Each code works only once.
mfa.invalid: Wrong, expired or already used code. Wait for the next code and try again.
mfa.useRecovery: No phone? Use a recovery code
mfa.useApp: Use a code from the app
mfa.lostPhone: Phone lost and no recovery code? Ask an Admin to reset your two-step verification.
mfa.recoveryDescription: Use one of these codes if your phone is lost or broken. Each code works only once.
mfa.recoveryWarning: These codes are shown only once. Keep them somewhere safe (a password manager or paper in a locked drawer), not on the same phone.
mfa.recoverySaved: I have saved the recovery codes in a safe place.

security.title: Account security
security.description: Two-step verification protects your account if your password leaks.
security.mfaDescription: A 6-digit code from the authenticator app is required at every sign-in.
security.recoveryLow: You are running out of recovery codes. Create new ones and save them.
security.regenerateDescription: Enter your current 6-digit code. All old recovery codes stop working at once.
security.lostPhone: New phone? Ask an Admin to reset your two-step verification, then set it up again at your next sign-in.
